summary: Revised enterprise implementation plan for offline administrator mode incorporating all 7 feedback conditions: 600,000 PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 iterations with dynamic device benchmarking, authenticated GCM canary decryption with zero standalone verification hashes, inspection of actual Supabase schemas without duplicate tables or unexecuted migrations, honest acknowledgment of client-side tamper limitations, strict isolation of offline recovery keys from live production privileges, absolute exclusion of service-role keys from storage, and full preservation of existing Zaboraa multi-cloud features.
